_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market (2026-10-11): moving_beacon-owner1/medium-scraper $0.01 per item (279 monthly users), fatihtahta/medium-scraper $0.00199 (6), easyapi/medium-posts-search-scraper $0.005 + $0.09 start (2). article $0.002 metadata; article_text $0.004 with the text (one extra GraphQL call per 10 articles). No start fee. Source: medium.com/_/graphql, no proxy; answers Apify IPs (home IPs get Cloudflare's block page).

article.eventDescription: One Medium article with title, subtitle, author and follower count, publication, published and updated dates, claps, responses, reading time, word count, tags and image. A source with no articles is free.

article_text.eventDescription: The same article plus its text, with headings, lists and code blocks (opening paragraphs only for members-only articles). Only with Article text on; charged instead of Article, not on top of it.
